result.title: CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing
result.comment: Accepted at 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Main Conference Track, 2026
result.summary: Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. Across diverse and fine-grained continual learning benchmarks, CaLLM consistently outperforms traditional isolation and replay methods, establishing prototype-based modular routing as a principled and scalable approach to lifelong adaptation of LLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CaLLM：将输入批次投影到任务无关嵌入空间并匹配最近原型，据此路由到专用轻量 adapter，以参数隔离和原型扩展实现 LLM 的持续适应，保持开销与任务数无关。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「嵌入空间最近原型路由 + 模块化参数隔离」可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 的 latent 计算路径选择与任务间干扰控制；但论文面向纯文本持续学习，未涉及视觉推理或推理期状态生成，联系需较多核查。
